content_summary: The page continues a discussion of sections of group extensions and a family of sections over residue fields, then generalizes a case of codimension one. It introduces a normal closure and local ring notation; a replacement changes a crossed word to stabilisateur. The page ends with numbered formula (29), containing I, N, an overwritten group term indexed by k(s), and endpoint 1. This is a description of the handwritten content, not a verification of the mathematical claims.
